display_long_description:
Visualize transforms your Meta Quest into a spatial design studio. Powered by AI and real-time depth mapping, it turns any room into a live canvas where you can visualize changes, test ideas, and make confident decisions — before you buy, build, or hire.

*  **Material Swap:** See your kitchen with marble countertops, your living room with hardwood floors, or your bedroom with new wall colors — all rendered live in your actual space.

*  **Room Makeover:** Describe your vision — "mid-century modern living room" or "minimalist Scandinavian kitchen" — and watch Aria Spark generate a complete redesign overlaid on your real room.

*   **Before & After:** Capture and compare your current space against proposed changes. Share screenshots with your designer, contractor, or partner.

*   **Virtual Staging:** Stage an empty listing with virtual furniture in minutes. Walk buyers through a fully furnished space without moving a single piece.

*   **Renovation Planning:** Show buyers the potential of a fixer-upper with live material swaps and layout changes during the showing.
